rationale: This round's blocker fix: the base of the branch diff is now PINNED to the tip that CONTAINS the other, so a stale local base can no longer widen the diff and let a merged predecessor's nomination read as this build's. Returning the ref that is BEHIND restores the hole: the stale-base regression case in the reader suite goes red (verified 27 pass / 1 fail mutated, 28 pass / 0 fail restored) while orchestrator.test.ts, whose refs all resolve to one sha so the containment branch is never taken, stays green (238 pass / 0 fail under the same mutation).
